summary: Live backend verification of Fix plan C1 (candle ingest R3/A1/A3/A10/A11). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_fixplan_c1_candles_live.py (5 tests, 4 passed, 1 xfail documenting a minor gap). All regression suites requested pass. Seeded a throwaway user + paper account via Mongo; cleaned up on teardown.

minor.issue: price_source field is omitted from the response when the signal exits via the cheap_hold / _hold() early-return (market closure, macro freeze, MTF cascade not aligned, 'no fresh M15 stream', regime dispatch no-op, engine note hold). A10 contract says the broker-tick vs public-quote source should be surfaced; it currently only appears on the full-run path where an actionable action is produced. Consider setting price_source inside _hold() (price_source is already resolved at line 142 before any _hold() call).

action_items: Minor: attach price_source to the _hold() early-exit shape in ai_signals.analyze_symbol so A10 is observable on every signal response, not only on actionable paths.
critical_code_review_comments: bridge_routes.py receive_candles correctly applies broker_offset_sec BEFORE validate_bars/split_forming_bar and persists t_basis='utc', broker_offset_sec, offset_source — verified against live DB.
validate_bars correctly rejects bad geometry, misaligned timestamps, non-positive/NaN prices and bars older than ~30 days, counted into candle_feed_health.dropped_bars.
intraday_candles merge keeps newest 800 bars by timestamp (OK for 8+ days of M15).
ai_signals._hold() short-circuit shape omits a few 'universal' telemetry fields (price_source, and potentially others needed by downstream consumers).

success_rate.backend: 100% (verified paths); 1 xfail on minor known gap
